hebrewText: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/יַּם ס֑וּף וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/מִדְבַּר סִֽין

tokens.bdb: properly, to pull up, especially the tent-pins, i.e. start on ajourney
tokens.kjv: cause to blow, bring, get, (make to) go (away, forth, forward, onward, out), (take) journey, march, remove, set aside (forward), [idiom] still, be on his (go their) way.

tokens.bdb: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a sea  or large body of water; specifically
tokens.enLiteralWord: a sea  or large body of water; specifically
tokens.explanation: a sea  or large body of water; specifically
tokens.explanationEn: a sea  or large body of water; specifically

tokens.bdb: properly, to incline; by implication, to decline (of the slanting rays of evening); specifically, to pitch atent; gen. to encamp (for abode or siege)
tokens.kjv: abide (in tents), camp, dwell, encamp, grow to an end, lie, pitch (tent), rest in tent.

tokens.bdb: a pasture (i.e. open field, whither cattle are driven); by implication, a desert; also speech (including its organs)
Sin the name of an Egyptian town and (probably) desert adjoining
tokens.ptLiteralWord: Sin the name of an Egyptian town and  desert adjoining
tokens.enLiteralWord: Sin the name of an Egyptian town and  desert adjoining
tokens.explanation: Sin the name of an Egyptian town and  desert adjoining
tokens.explanationEn: Sin the name of an Egyptian town and  desert adjoining
